==Background==
ONEOK, WhiteWater, MPLX and Enbridge announced the Eiger Express Pipeline on August 25, 2025. The approximately 450-mile, 42-inch pipeline is designed to carry up to approximately 2.5 billion cubic feet per day of natural gas from the Permian Basin in West Texas to the Katy area near Houston.<ref name="r326613" /> The Matterhorn joint venture owns 70% of the Eiger Express joint venture, and ONEOK and MPLX each own 15%. WhiteWater was to build and operate the pipeline.<ref name="r326613" /> The companies expected it to be finished in mid-2028, pending regulatory approvals.<ref name="r326613" />

A Gattis Law project page said the partners reached a final investment decision in August 2025 and that construction and regulatory approvals were under way.<ref name="r9d8849">{{Cite web|url=https://gattislaw.com/projects/eiger-express-pipeline/|title=Eiger Express Pipeline: 450-Mile Permian to Gulf Coast Gas Project (2026 Update)|website=gattislaw.com|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>
